Paragraph: "The mountain streams flow down crystal clear, carrying fallen petals like floating jewels upon the water..."
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama notices the serene and graceful movement of water and flowers.
Outcome/Resolution: He finds momentary peace in observing the clear water.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Sensory Calming, Visual Tracking, Mindful Presence

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Nirmalatva (Purity and clarity represented by flowing stream water)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Flowing crystal water represents the pure flow of consciousness carrying thoughts (petals) without becoming polluted.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Engaging in sensory tracking of gentle, natural movement to foster moment-to-moment psychological calm.
